Island is a new screen-time app that turns staying off your phone into a game. YC-backed Island turns screen time goals into a farming game, rewarding users with new crops, animals, and more when they stick to their limits.

Noeri raises $110M to help companies build living AI systems that self-improve over time. Noeri Inc., a startup developing artificial intelligence systems that continuously improve their outputs as they learn from an organization’s data and work, is launching with $110 million in funding. BlueMatrix Acquires Aiera to Bring Governed AI Distribution to Investment Research. Your research is feeding AI models, and nobody’s checking who gets credit. BlueMatrix just bought NYC’s Aiera to fix that. The goal: every report carries its author, its rights, and an audit trail from the first draft to the final query.
